messages:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT PAGE — Smart routing error spike and rapid region failovers observed for customer-facing endpoints. Alert: routing_fallback_rate >= 60% for last 3m. Impact: elevated 5xx and wrong-model routing. Assign: oncall @ashok

Ashok Patel: seeing big oscillation across us-west/us-east -> clients getting slow responses, some requests hitting tiny-quantized model-variant (v1-quant) unexpectedly. Paging SRE.

Maria Chen: @ashok I'm on it. Quick question: did the config schema migration go out last night? I recall change to 'fallback_policy' shape.

Ashok Patel: yes, deploy at 01:12 UTC. We migrated schema and deprecated `default_variant` in favor of `variant_selection`. Looks like deprecated field left present in some older service configs.

Devin Rao: I'm pulling routing logs now. Repro: requests with no explicit variant are getting `legacy_default: "v1-quant"` because the new parser treats missing `variant_selection` as empty and falls back to legacy default. That should've been blocked by validation.

Jyoti Kapoor: oh no. So services that didn't update their config are silently switching to the legacy default. That explains wrong-model routing + higher latency as v1-quant can't handle the load.

OpsBot: @channel adding mitigation checklist: 1) roll routing schema back? 2) override per-customer routing to pin to stable variant 3) throttle fallbacks

Maria Chen: rollback is risky for many tenants. Let's try targeted override + increase capacity for stable variants. Can SRE push an emergency policy to disable legacy_default fallback?

Ashok Patel: I can push an override at control-plane level to set `legacy_default` -> null for all tenant configs. Doing a dry-run first. @Devin can you prepare a grep of affected tenants?

Devin Rao: running: `git grep -n \"legacy_default\" --configs | wc -l` -> ~83 tenants. I'll dump list and mark top-10 by traffic.

PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by oncall (Ashok Patel). Priority: P1. Escalation policy: SRE lead, infra eng.

Jyoti Kapoor: Customer impact: - Increased 5xx for realtime chat models, embeddings throughput hit for a few mid-size tenants. Noting two enterprise customers reported timeouts. Recording ops->support handoff.

Maria Chen: I'm drafting comms to support with mitigations + ETA. Short note: 'We observed an automatic routing fallback to a legacy model due to a schema compatibility bug; teams are being pinned to stable variants. No data exfiltration.'

Ashok Patel: control-plane override applied in dry-run. Now applying live: `POST /internal/overrides` payload: ```json
{"scope":"tenant:*","patch":{"routing.legacy_default":null}}
```

Devin Rao: override accepted, propagation started. Watching metrics.

10m later — OpsBot: Metric check: fallback_rate dropped from 64% -> 9% in 3m. 5xx rate declining. Early signs good. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: support comms sent. Notifying affected account reps.

Jyoti Kapoor: followup: need schema validator to reject configs containing deprecated `legacy_default` field during migration. Also add a canary in config-service to surface defaults.

Ashok Patel: Agreed. I'll open follow-up tickets: one to add stricter validation + migration audit, one to add metric alert for 'legacy-default-usage'.

Devin Rao: putting a temporary autoscale bump on stable variants to soak traffic until we complete rollout.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Oncall handoff scheduled to SRE next shift (Devin to take over).

Devin Rao: taking over monitoring. Will run regression test and a retrospective draft.

Maria Chen: tl;dr doc: bug in schema migration allowed deprecated field to silently remain, new parser treated missing new field as no-op causing fallback to legacy default model -> cascade. Mitigated with control-plane override and autoscale. Postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.

Ashok Patel: Closing page for now. If anything regresses ping me directly. :pray:
